name: WebQuick SEO by Rankify
author: rankifysa

sections.description:
WebQuick SEO by Rankify Pty Ltd puts the tools of a premium SEO suite in one plugin, with nothing locked behind a licence key, trial or upgrade.

Search appearance

  • Title and meta description templates for every post type, taxonomy, author, date, search and 404 page
  • Smart tags such as {post_title}, {site_title}, {sep}, {category}, {author}, {year}
  • Per-post and per-term overrides, noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, canonical URL, primary category
  • Live search result preview, on-page SEO analysis, readability checks and headline score in the editor
  • Search engine verification tags (Google, Bing, Yandex, Baidu, Pinterest)

Social

  • Open Graph and X (Twitter) card tags with per-post titles, descriptions and images
  • Default share image, Facebook App ID, X username

Schema markup (JSON-LD)

  • One clean @graph with Organization or Person, WebSite (with search action), WebPage, BreadcrumbList, Article, BlogPosting and NewsArticle
  • Per-post schema for FAQ, How-To, Recipe, Event, Product, Course, Job Posting, Software Application, Service, Review, Book, Video and Person
  • Custom JSON-LD field for advanced users

Sitemaps

  • XML sitemap index with images, taxonomies, authors and additional pages
  • Google News sitemap and video sitemap (YouTube embeds)
  • HTML sitemap shortcode: [ultseo_html_sitemap]
  • Browser-friendly sitemap stylesheet, caching and automatic refresh

Redirects and 404 monitor

  • 301, 302, 307, 308, 410 and 451 redirects with exact, prefix and regular-expression matching
  • Automatic redirect when a published post’s URL changes
  • 404 log with hit counts and one-click redirect creation
  • CSV import and export

Local SEO

  • Multiple business locations with opening hours, geo coordinates and areas served
  • LocalBusiness schema and shortcodes: [ultseo_location], [ultseo_locations], [ultseo_opening_hours]

WooCommerce SEO

  • GTIN, MPN and brand fields, Product schema with price, stock and reviews
  • Noindex for cart, checkout and account pages

Editing

  • Live character counters (used and left) on the title and description
  • Block Editor sidebar, plus the full WebQuick SEO box below the content

Elementor and score gauge

  • Edit the focus keyphrase, SEO title, description, robots and social fields inside the Elementor editor (Page Settings > WebQuick SEO)
  • A colour-coded 0-100 SEO score gauge beside every page and post in the admin list, sortable, with improvement tips on hover

More

  • Image SEO: automatic alt text and title attributes from templates, attachment page redirects
  • Breadcrumbs: [ultseo_breadcrumbs] shortcode and ultseo_breadcrumbs() template function
  • Internal link suggestions in the editor
  • SEO revisions: restore earlier titles and descriptions
  • robots.txt editor, one-click blocking of known AI training crawlers, crawl cleanup
  • RSS feed attribution
  • IndexNow (optional, off by default)
  • Author SEO, role-based access control
  • Import from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress; export and import settings
  • Feature manager to switch off any module you do not need

WebQuick SEO is an independent product of Rankify Pty Ltd. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the authors of any plugin it can import data from. Those names are used only to describe import compatibility.

External services

This plugin does not contact any external service by default.

IndexNow (optional)

If you enable IndexNow under WebQuick SEO > Settings > Features, the plugin sends the URL of a post, along with your site’s hostname and a randomly generated key, to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow each time that post is published or updated. This tells participating search engines the page has changed. No personal data is sent. Terms and privacy: https://www.indexnow.org/

Links shown to visitors

The [ultseo_location] shortcode shows a “Get directions” link to Google Maps. No request is made to Google unless a visitor clicks it. The video sitemap lists YouTube thumbnail URLs for search engines; your server does not download them.

Privacy

The 404 monitor stores the missing URL, the referring URL and a hit count. It does not store IP addresses, user agents or user identifiers. Entries are deleted automatically after the retention period you set (30 days by default).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the webquick-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WebQuick SEO in the admin menu and follow the setup checklist.
  4. If you use another SEO plugin, deactivate it and use WebQuick SEO > Tools to import its data first.
sections.faq:
Is anything locked behind a paid version?

No. Every feature listed here is included in this plugin.

Will it conflict with my current SEO plugin?

Run only one SEO plugin at a time. Import your data from WebQuick SEO > Tools, then deactivate the old plugin.

Where is my sitemap?

At /sitemap.xml. This replaces the default WordPress sitemap. If it returns a 404, visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save.

Does the plugin send data to anyone?

No, unless you turn on IndexNow. See the External services section.

How do I remove all data?

Tick Delete all plugin data under WebQuick SEO > Settings > Advanced, then delete the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.6.1 – 2026-11-27

  • Fixed: schema chosen per page (FAQ, How-To, Recipe, Video, Event and the other types) is now output on the page. The details you entered were saved but not printed.

1.6.0 – 2026-11-26

  • New: Go Pro screen in the WebQuick SEO menu showing the planned Pro plans, and a Go Pro link on the Plugins page.
  • New: Documentation screen in the menu.
  • Changed: Dashboard is now first in the menu; Documentation and Go Pro are last.
  • Fixed: notices from other plugins no longer appear inside the WebQuick SEO header.
  • Fixed: the menu icon no longer flashes black before it turns white.
  • Compatibility: tested with WordPress 7.2.

1.5.4 – 2026-11-23

  • Changed: the plugin is now called WebQuick SEO (slug webquick-seo) following the WordPress.org plugin review.
  • Security: request URIs are now sanitised before use in the redirect and IndexNow handlers.
  • Changed: the XML sitemap stylesheet now loads its CSS from an enqueued file instead of inline markup.

1.5.3 – 2026-11-23

  • Security: request URIs are now sanitised before use in the redirect and IndexNow handlers.
  • Changed: the XML sitemap stylesheet now loads its CSS from an enqueued file instead of inline markup.

1.5.2 – 2026-11-21

  • New: Documentation links in the plugin header, the Plugins page (next to View details) and the dashboard quick links.

1.5.1 – 2026-11-21

  • Fixed: settings were not saved the first time (when no settings had been stored yet), so nothing carried over to later versions. Settings now save correctly from the very first save.

1.5.0 – 2026-11-20

  • New: [ultseo_posts] shortcode, a responsive grid of recent posts with pagination, for blog pages built in page builders (attributes: count, category, columns, paginate).

1.4.3 – 2026-11-19

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.5.
  • Plugin links now point to the WebQuick SEO page.

1.4.1 – 2026-11-19

  • Compliance: custom table names are now escaped before use in database queries (clears all Plugin Check warnings).
  • Fix: removed a deprecated WordPress parameter in term descriptions (taxonomy archive titles and descriptions) that newer WordPress versions flag.
  • Compliance: passed the WordPress.org plugin-review coding rules and Plugin Check with no errors or warnings; tested on WordPress 7.1.4, including upgrades from earlier versions with settings and page SEO data intact.

1.4.0 – 2026-11-19

  • New: “Buy me a coffee” and “Go Pro” links in the plugin header. Two small static links: no notices, banners or pop-ups. All current features remain free.
  • New: Donate link added to the plugin directory page.
  • New: developer filter ultseo_is_pro so a future Pro add-on can hide the Go Pro link.

1.3.1 – 2026-11-18

  • Security: the 404 monitor now rate-limits new log entries, so bots requesting endless random URLs cannot flood the database.
  • Fix: social images (og:image / twitter:image) from your own site are now output over https on https sites, avoiding mixed-content warnings.
  • Full code security review: every form handler and REST route confirmed to check capabilities and nonces, database queries prepared, output escaped.

1.3.0 – 2026-11-18

  • Fix: saving a page in Elementor could erase its saved SEO title/description if the WebQuick SEO panel had not loaded. Elementor saves now only touch SEO data when the panel was actually open.
  • Fix: the Block Editor sync can no longer blank the SEO fields while a post is still loading.
  • New: live “used / left” character counters for SEO title and description inside the Elementor editor.
  • New: automatic settings backups. Settings are snapshotted on every version change (last 5 kept) and restored automatically if the settings record ever goes missing.
  • New: “Your data” card under WebQuick SEO > Tools showing settings and per-page SEO data counts, the last upgrade, and one-click restore from a backup.

1.2.0 – 2026-11-18

  • New: Live character counters on the SEO title and meta description showing characters used and left (and how many over), with colour coding.
  • New: Block Editor sidebar. Edit the keyphrase, title, description, robots, canonical and social fields from the WebQuick SEO sidebar, with search result preview and counters.
  • New: “View details” popup on the Plugins page with the full changelog, and a “What’s new” card on the dashboard. Both read this changelog, so new entries appear automatically.

1.1.1 – 2026-11-18

  • Elementor: panel no longer limited to specific Elementor document classes (fixes it not appearing in newer Elementor versions).
  • New: Elementor status card under WebQuick SEO > Tools to diagnose the panel.

1.1.0 – 2026-11-18

  • New: Elementor support. An WebQuick SEO section in Elementor’s Page Settings, synced with the normal SEO fields.
  • New: SEO score gauge column in the Pages and Posts lists, sortable, with a “Recalculate all scores” tool.
  • New: Feature switches for the score gauge and Elementor panel.
  • Fix: Settings import now saves correctly.
  • Fix: Text truncation could corrupt some non-English characters.

1.0.0 – 2026-11-18

  • Initial release.
